title: Strictly henselian singleton open neighbourhoods
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and $C$ a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] of topological Krull dimension at most zero [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. For each $c\in C$, let $s_c:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_c\to C$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] with image $c$. Then there are opens $U_c\subset C$ [def-weil-open-immersion] with underlying sets $\{c\}$ and morphisms $t_c:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_c\to U_c$ satisfying $t_c\circ\iota_c=s_c$. For every $c$ there is a commutative local ring $R_c$ which is strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] and an isomorphism $e_c:U_c\cong\operatorname{Spec}R_c$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], such that $e_c\circ t_c$ has image the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}R_c$.

source.place: Tags 00KH (lemma-Noetherian-dimension-0), 00FV (theorem-nullstellensatz), and 06RS (lemma-local-dimension-zero-henselian); singleton-open construction in parent proof steps 1-2

proof.text: By [new-zdbp-geometry], C is discrete. Set U_c to the open singleton {c}. The image of s_c is {c}, so Mathlib IsOpenImmersion.lift gives t_c with t_c followed by the inclusion equal to s_c. These constructions are pointwise, including empty C.

source.place: Parent proof step 1; definition of an open immersion and its factorization property

proof.text: Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.Limits gives IsAffine for any singleton scheme. Put R_c = Gamma(U_c, top), and use U_c.isoSpec. Its prime spectrum is a nonempty singleton, so R_c is nonzero, its maximal spectrum is a singleton, and IsLocalRing.of_singleton_maximalSpectrum makes it local. The singleton prime spectrum gives Ring.KrullDimLE 0 R_c, equivalently ringKrullDim R_c = 0.

source.place: Parent proof step 1; Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.Limits singleton IsAffine instance, RingTheory.LocalRing.MaximalIdeal.Basic and KrullDimension.Zero

proof.text: The composite Spec R_c -> U_c -> C -> Spec k is locally of finite type, since isomorphisms and open immersions are so. Its closed point is closed in the singleton spectrum. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-closed-point-residue-field-base], implemented by residueFieldIsoBase. The stalkClosedPointIso and IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv identify the scheme residue field with the local-ring residue field. Thus the latter is algebraically closed, hence separably closed.

source.place: Tag 00FV (theorem-nullstellensatz), applied to the singleton open

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-dimension-zero-local-strictly-henselian] to R_c and take its strictly henselian conclusion. The image of t_c followed by e_c is the only prime, hence the closed point. This supplies all the required data.
